products.name: ServiceNow SAM — Request Fulfillment & License Reclamation Workflow — Commercial
products.short_description: Design a repeatable ServiceNow SAM workflow for the full request lifecycle — intake and triage, entitlement and fulfillment, and automated reclamation — with the catalog items, workflows, and reporting that make license operations measured and auditable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Run software requests and reclamation as a clean ServiceNow workflow

When software requests live in email and reclamation never happens, the service desk drowns and licenses leak. This solution designs a repeatable ServiceNow SAM workflow for the full request lifecycle — intake and triage, entitlement and fulfillment, and automated reclamation of unused licenses — with the catalog items, workflows, and reporting that turn license operations into a measured, auditable process.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the ServiceNow SAM/ITAM model, the request lifecycle (intake → triage → entitlement → fulfillment → reclamation), catalog items and workflows, and reporting.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a ServiceNow instance with SAM/ITAM, entitlement/CMDB data, discovery integration, roles and approvals) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. ServiceNow-specific configuration is deferred to ServiceNow's documentation.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the catalog items and intake, build triage and fulfillment workflows, wire entitlement and reclamation, set reporting and KPIs, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell/integration scripts — request/entitlement discovery helper, fulfillment-data validation, a request and reclamation report, safe remediation of stale entitlements, and a scope/assignment helper. (ServiceNow data via the Table API where available.)
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Software requests and reclamation run as a clean, auditable ServiceNow workflow — intake to fulfillment to reclamation — so the service desk keeps pace and licenses stop leaking, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SNOWSAM-Discovery.ps1 — read request, entitlement, and usage records from ServiceNow (read-only)
    • SNOWSAM-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of stale entitlement assignments (default -WhatIf)
    • SNOWSAM-Report.ps1 — request and reclamation KPI report from ServiceNow (read-only)
    • SNOWSAM-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — record and expand which products and groups are in workflow scope
    • SNOWSAM-Validation.ps1 — confirm the workflow artifacts and entitlement data are present (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
